_comment: Sleeper contest-variant payout data. UNLIKE underdog_payouts.json, Sleeper's payout is NOT a full table -- the real payout for Max is the live product of each leg's payout_multiplier (Boost_Over/Boost_Under from books.py, consumed as g.boosts) times 'power'[size]; Flex payout is a runtime devig+Poisson-binomial calculation, see payouts.py::sleeper_flex_payout_curve -- 'flex_k' below holds ONLY the small K(n,k) constants that calculation reads. 'power' (2-3 legs, all-or-nothing) CONFIRMED from independent in-app trials: size 2 = 1.0 (no bonus), size 3 = 1.0797. 'flex_k' (sizes 4-6, indexed by miss count starting at 0): n=5/n=6 rows HIGH CONFIDENCE (research-analyst independent re-derivation, median 1.5%/worst 4.5% reconstruction error, external Sleeper-support-doc corroboration). n=4 row PROVISIONAL (fit from 3 clean paired samples only, 20-23% spread) -- Kelly's shrinkage discounts this uncertainty, but check n=4 first if Flex pricing looks off. Row lengths encode Sleeper's own documented tier rule (n=4: 2 tiers, n=5/6: 3 tiers) -- do not pad extra tiers. 'flex' is NOT a priced value -- it's sum(flex_k[size]), an exact composition-independent identity, used only as a coarse beam-search pre-filter ranking heuristic (payouts.py::payout_curve_for). This stage prices Flex assuming no leg pushes -- see docs/handoffs/sleeper-parity.md stage 1 for why.
